Hi Laura / Acme procurement team,

As we approach your contract renewal (term end: 2028-06-30) we wanted to surface two items that will help accelerate the renewal + staged capacity increase you discussed with our Sales team last week:

1) Vendor onboarding / credential refresh: your security team asked for an updated SOC 2 summary and a fresh vendor profile in Acme’s procurement portal so the SCC can reissue approval. I’ve attached a short SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and can provide additional evidence if needed.

2) PO split for staged capacity: Acme noted you prefer a 3-stage PO (initial renewal + two incremental POs as usage ramps). To make procurement operations simpler we can provide a pre-filled PO split template and suggested stagger dates tied to usage thresholds.

Action items I propose:
- Laura: confirm if Acme wants the PO split split into three line-items (renewal / +25% uplift / +50% uplift) or separate POs.
- Procurement: If you can re-open a portal request number, we’ll upload the vendor profile and evidence.
- Ben/Jordan (cc’d): we’ll prepare the PO template and a short on-demand runbook for your procurement system.

Tentative timeline: if we get confirmation this week we can have the vendor profile live in the portal and the draft PO(s) to you by Wed, June 6.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min sync if that helps.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Renewals & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

- For procurement, we prefer separate POs (one for the renewal term, then separate POs for later capacity increases). It reduces the need for mid-contract amendments in our ERP.
- Portal: I reopened request #4821 and added a note asking for the vendor profile and SOC 2 summary. The portal requires a short CSV of the vendor contact list and a confirmation of data retention policies.

Can your team provide:
- PO split template (sample lines + recommended effective dates)

I can fast-track this on our side once the file is uploaded. If Ben/Jordan can attach the template here (or drop it into the portal link), I’ll circulate it to Acme finance.

Laura — attached is our PO split template (po-split-template.xlsx). Key points in the template:

- Option A: Separate POs (recommended by Acme) -> three separate POs, each incremental PO references the master SOW and provides an estimated uplift window.
- Option B: Single Master PO with contingent increments (if you later prefer amendments).

Also below is a short data retention blurb you can paste into the portal: 
"Redwood Inference retains customer data (request logs, prompt/response artifacts used for service delivery) for up to 90 days by default in hosted deployments; for Dedicated/Private deployments, retention is governed by customer configuration and contractual terms. Redwood does not use customer prompt/response content to train models. Detailed retention options are available in our SOC 2 evidence bundle."

We’ve also uploaded a vendor contact CSV to the request you reopened (portal link in Naomi’s original note).

Forwarding attachments: po-split-template.xlsx
